payload.title: GPT 第五轮 V1-V6 验证：P1 强单调成立；P2 为近对称鞍点，V1/V2/V3 被杀死

payload.scope: GPT round-5 routes V1-V6 validation (paradigm-level, non-Koopman) via T5-A/B/C/E

verdicts.V1 CSMRO: KILLED on P2: local response Jacobian symmetric part 99.71% indefinite (saddle), PD 0.29%, ND 0%; P1 supports (92.57% PD)
verdicts.V2 CMPD (convex potential/Legendre dual): KILLED on P2: near-symmetric (curl 0.05) but indefinite -> saddle potential, not convex
verdicts.V3 MMICR (maximal monotone relation): KILLED on P2: monotone operators require PSD symmetric part; saddle is not monotone
verdicts.V4 FMOSI: not tested; prior-art very high (Chen-Fliess/Volterra); backup only
verdicts.V5 AFISC: premise weak: conditional ambiguity only 0.21 (not dominant); needs new probing data
verdicts.V6 MSIC: out of frozen-data scope; strategic fallback

key_findings: P1 control response is strongly monotone (92.57% PD symmetric part) consistent with M(q)>>0
P2 control response is a near-symmetric saddle: 99.71% indefinite, PD 0.29%, ND 0%, curl 0.05
P2 is nearly deterministic (ambiguity 0.21) and locally invertible (sigma_min 9.6e-4) but NOT monotone/convex
No single invertible-response geometry unifies P1 and P2
payload.meta: After R(18)/N(6)/M(12)/Q(7)/V(6), still no candidate survives gate v0.2.
payload.user_directive: validate + feedback only, do not invent new routes
